sentences.text: authenticity of this order/judgment Counsel for the complainant submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that he had duped the complainant of Rs.13 lakhs out of which Rs.5.50 lakhs was entrusted to the petitioner.

Be that as it may, noticing the nature of allegations levelled against the petitioner as well as after hearing the State counsel and examining the incriminating material placed on the record by the State, this Court is of the view that the petitioner deserves to be granted interim protection.

Petitioner is directed to appear before the Investigating Officer on 01.08.2024 at 10:00 A.M. at Police Station Civil Lines, Batala, District Gurdaspur and join the investigation and appear as and when called by the Investigating Officer.
In the event of arrest, he shall be admitted to interim bail on furnishing personal and surety bonds to the satisfaction of Arresting/Investigating Officer.
He shall also abide by the conditions as specified under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C."

2. Upon instructions received from SI, Manohar Singh, State counsel submits that the petitioner has joined the investigation pursuant to order dated 22.07.2024 passed by this Court, cooperated with the Investigating Agency and he is no longer required for custodial interrogation.
3. In view of the above, but without commenting upon the merits of the allegations, petition is allowed.
Order dated 22.07.2024 is made absolute , subject to satisfaction of conditions laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
(SUVI  12.12.2024 J  Kamal  Whether Speaking/Reasoned Yes/No
